# GrossLivingArea

> GrossLivingArea.com is a reference guide to gross living area (GLA) and the ANSI Z765-2021 square footage standard. It answers "does this space count as square footage" questions for homeowners, buyers, agents and appraisers, one question per page.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- Free to read, no account or signup.
- Covers ANSI Z765-2021, the residential square footage standard Fannie Mae requires for appraisals. Answers rest on ANSI Z765 plus Fannie Mae and FHA appraisal guidance.
- The counting rules are the same in every US state. State pages differ only by data (EIA Residential Energy Consumption Survey and Census Survey of Construction figures on basements and housing), not by law.
- GrossLivingArea explains the standard in plain English. It does not reproduce the ANSI text, and rule names such as "finished-connection rule" are the site's own shorthand, not official ANSI terminology.
- US only. Not a building code, permit or property tax assessor guide.

## Guides

- [Home](https://grosslivingarea.com/): Overview of gross living area and links to both guides.
- [ANSI Z765-2021 Explained: Every Rule in Plain English](https://grosslivingarea.com/ansi-z765-2021): ANSI Z765-2021 is the square footage standard Fannie Mae requires. Every rule in plain English: ceiling height, above grade, stairs, what counts, what never does.
- [What Counts as Square Footage?](https://grosslivingarea.com/what-counts-as-square-footage): What is included in the square footage of a house? A counts / does not count table for every space (basements, garages, attics, porches, ADUs) under ANSI Z765.

## Reference

- [Gross Living Area FAQ](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq): Short answers to common gross living area questions.
- [Does gross living area include the garage?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/does-gross-living-area-include-the-garage)
- [What is the difference between gross floor area and gross square footage?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/gross-floor-area-vs-gross-square-footage)
- [How do you calculate gross area?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/how-do-you-calculate-gross-area)
- [What does gross area mean?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/what-does-gross-area-mean)
- [What does gross living area include?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/what-does-gross-living-area-include)
- [Does gross square footage include exterior walls?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/does-gross-square-footage-include-exterior-walls)
- [What is the difference between gross area and net area?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/gross-area-vs-net-area)
- [Is a bathroom considered a living space?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/is-a-bathroom-considered-living-space)
- [What is not included in the square footage of a house?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/what-is-not-included-in-square-footage-of-a-house)
- [What is the difference between gross living area and square footage?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/gross-living-area-vs-square-footage)
- [What is considered finished square footage?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/what-is-considered-finished-square-footage)
- [Why is the square footage on my appraisal different from the listing?](https://grosslivingarea.com/faq/why-is-appraisal-square-footage-different-from-listing)
- [Gross Living Area Glossary](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary): Definitions of square footage and appraisal terms.
- [Gross living area](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/gross-living-area): The finished, above-grade living space of a house, measured to the outside of the exterior walls.
- [American Measurement Standard](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/american-measurement-standard): A voluntary guide for measuring, calculating, and reporting square footage in homes.
- [Real estate appraisal](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/real-estate-appraisal): An appraiser's opinion of what a property is worth, built on comparisons with similar sales.
- [American National Standards Institute](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/american-national-standards-institute): The private nonprofit that accredits American standards, including ANSI Z765.
- [Square foot](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/square-foot): The unit American homes are measured in, equal to about 0.0929 square meters.
- [Building envelope](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/building-envelope): The walls, roof, and foundation that separate a home's inside from the outdoors.
- [Real estate](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/real-estate): Land and the buildings permanently attached to it, plus the business of trading them.
- [Basement](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/basement): A level of a house partly or fully below ground, reported apart from living area.
- [Single-family detached home](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/single-family-detached-home): A freestanding house for one household, the property type ANSI Z765 was written for.
- [International Property Measurement Standards](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/international-property-measurement-standards): Standards for measuring buildings the same way in every country.
- [Square meter](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/square-meter): The metric unit of area, equal to about 10.764 square feet.
- [Appraisal Institute](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/appraisal-institute): A professional association of real estate appraisers, known for the MAI and SRA designations.
- [Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/uspap): The ethical and performance standards U.S. appraisers follow when they appraise property.
- [The Appraisal Foundation](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/appraisal-foundation): The nonprofit that writes USPAP and sets qualifications for U.S. appraisers.
- [Mortgage](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/mortgage): A loan secured by a home, and the reason most home appraisals are ordered.
- [Building Owners and Managers Association](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/boma): A commercial real estate group whose standards measure office and other buildings.
- [House](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/house): A building people live in, and the thing gross living area measures.
- [Mezzanine](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/mezzanine): A partial floor open to the level below, like a loft.
- [Floor area ratio](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/floor-area-ratio): A building's total floor area divided by the area of its lot.
- [Architecture](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/architecture): The design of buildings, where floor plans and wall lines are set.
- [Zoning](https://grosslivingarea.com/glossary/zoning): Local rules that control how land can be used and what can be built on it.
